title: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-02-TOOL-01-two-stage – Predictive biomarkers using AI for non-communicable diseases (Horizon Europe Health, RIA)
description: Whether to apply depends on the reference requirements. For Parsa's products at TRL 3-5, grant calls such as Horizon Europe Health and Digital Europe may suit you better than tenders, since tenders usually want proven references. AI-based predictive biomarker development for chronic non-communicable diseases. Two-stage call opened 29 Oct 2026; stage 1 due 17 Feb 2027 and stage 2 due 16 Sep 2027 per the FFG national contact page and Accelopment (an earlier draft listed 13 Apr 2027). Budget ~EUR 44.2M for ~6 projects. More: https://www.ffg.at/en/europa/heu/cluster1/call2027-twostage تاریخ‌ها و شرایط از منابع ثانویه آمده است؛ پیش از هر اقدام در پورتال رسمی Funding & Tenders تأیید شود.

title: EIC Accelerator 2027 – grant + equity for single SMEs (open to health and AI deep-tech)
description: Whether to apply depends on the reference requirements. For Parsa's products at TRL 3-5, grant calls such as Horizon Europe Health and Digital Europe may suit you better than tenders, since tenders usually want proven references. EIC Accelerator supports single start-ups/SMEs (short application, then full proposal). First 2027 cut-off for full applications: 3 Feb 2027, then further cut-offs every 2-3 months (dates to be set in the 2027 EIC Work Programme). 2026 cut-offs were 7 Jan, 4 Mar, 6 May, 8 Jul, 2 Sep, 4 Nov. Info day (Turkish national contact point): 19 Nov 2026. تاریخ‌ها و شرایط از منابع ثانویه آمده است؛ پیش از هر اقدام در پورتال رسمی Funding & Tenders تأیید شود.
deadline_fa: نخستین cut-off سال 2027: 3 فوریه 2027 (بعدی‌ها هر ۲ تا ۳ ماه)
